text: Foster carer here, I've had Malik (3 months) since Tuesday. His temperature is 38.8. I think his breathing's off. He's breathing much faster than usual, I counted and lost track. I can see the skin pulling in under his ribs each breath, and there's a little grunt at the end of some of them. Not sure, but I think he paused once or twice too. Might be nothing but I'd rather ask. What should I do?
